This nonexecutable synthetic encrypted-envelope fixture exercises the production
transport representation only. It contains no production key or bytecode.
The nonce/tag/ciphertext are placeholders and are not an executable artifact.

`transport.patch` was generated by the actual updater `patch` binary:

```
../updater/target/release/patch /dev/null \
  testdata/interpreter_transport/envelope.json \
  testdata/interpreter_transport/transport.patch
```

The manifest records encoder source/binary provenance and distinct installed and
transport SHA-256 values. The server reconstructs only the publisher's exact
single-literal empty-base representation; it never decrypts the envelope or
assumes that an arbitrary binary diff can be reconstructed without its baseline.

For live producer/consumer HTTP tests, set `SHOREBIRD_TEST_PATCH_ENCODER` to that
pinned executable. Standalone Go tests also consume this committed production
encoder fixture, without requiring Rust or another repository.
